_comment: The image fields an INFO reply carries alongside the identity. These arrive as a subprocess's JSON, so a wrong type reaching the digest comparison reads as a mismatch against every artifact - and absence is never mismatch, so dropping a malformed field is the whole point. Each guard has to be shown load-bearing.

mutations.name: a bool is not an int here
mutations.find: if isinstance(value, int) and not isinstance(value, bool):

mutations.name: an image field of the wrong type is dropped, not carried
an empty version string is absence, not a version
the wire source answers absence rather than raising at its caller
a discovered device carries what INFO reported
